description: This file is a TypeScript source file providing private helper surfaces, type exports, and setup functions for the bundled Tlon plugin within a larger project. It primarily manages module imports/exports, defines a specific setup surface, and exposes certain configurations and helpers related to the Tlon plugin.

methods.name: createOptionalChannelSetupSurface
methods.description: Creates a configurable setup surface for a specific channel, here used for the 'tlon' channel with labeling and npm specification.

methods.name: buildChannelConfigSchema
methods.description: Generates or retrieves the channel configuration schema used for validation and structure definition.

methods.name: applyAccountNameToChannelSection
methods.description: Helper to apply account naming conventions or defaults within channel sections.

methods.name: patchScopedAccountConfig
methods.description: Modifies or extends account configuration in a scoped manner.

methods.name: createChannelReplyPipeline
methods.description: Creates a pipeline for processing channel replies, used in the plugin's reply handling.

methods.name: createDedupeCache
methods.description: Creates a cache to prevent duplicate processing of requests or messages.

methods.name: fetchWithSsrFGuard
methods.description: Fetch function with SSR Fallback Guard to handle SSR contexts securely.

methods.name: isBlockedHostnameOrIp
methods.description: Checks if a hostname or IP is blocked by SSRF policies.

methods.name: SsrFBlockedError
methods.description: Error class thrown when a blocked hostname or IP is detected.

methods.name: emptyPluginConfigSchema
methods.description: Provides an empty or default schema for plugin configuration.

methods.name: buildComputedAccountStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Builds a snapshot of account status, likely for UI or logging.

methods.name: formatDocsLink
methods.description: Formats documentation links, probably for display or linking.

methods.name: createLoggerBackedRuntime
methods.description: Creates a runtime object with logger support for the plugin environment.
